question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget land now as a sessions.list-backed builtin, or should this issue wait for the richer sessions.activity Gateway contract before implementation?
rationale: The requested operator view is coherent, but the durable source of truth for current task, progress, awaiting-input, and cross-agent activity is a product/API choice automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Proceed with sessions.list-backed widget
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the implementation candidate, while requiring conflict resolution, review blockers, and real behavior proof before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for sessions.activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 defines the richer activity API, then implement the widget against that stable source.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing, but preserve this issue's unique status-widget details before closing or superseding it.

recommendation.title: Proceed with sessions.list-backed widget
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the implementation candidate, while requiring conflict resolution, review blockers, and real behavior proof before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decisive unresolved question is the Gateway session-activity semantics, and vincentkoc is assigned to the broader per-session activity contract issue this item references.
